https://arxiv.org/html/2512.09108
Evolving Excellence: Automated Optimization of LLM-based Agents. Key findings: Mutation uses LLM ensembles for semantic-aware mutations preserving validity. Selection uses multi-stage filtering (cheap LLM scoring then expensive benchmark). Fitness function f maps agent configs through benchmarks. Population config C=(P,T,M,Theta) covers prompts, tools, models, parameters. Local optimization uses GA for independent components, global uses Bayesian for interacting components. Generalization validated via stratified sampling and held-out test sets. Results: ALE +13.6%, Mini-SWE +10.1%, CrewAI -36.9% cost, MathTales +22% accuracy. Population size 3, generations 2-3, optimization time 9-411 hours depending on benchmark complexity.
